title: MEIKO — A Name Held Dear〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I suppose I'll spend another day leisurely watching over the SEKAI while I sing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh? This is...a fragment of a feeling.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hm...? I think I just heard...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Their voice...
Is it coming from this fragment...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, I can't leave it be just because it's only a fragment!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let me get in touch with your feelings.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (The place has a classy, quiet feel to it... But something about it makes my heart feel tight...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
This sheet of paper...was somebody writing?
It's been crumpled up into a ball, though...

rows.Speaker: Somebody's Writing
rows.Line:
• Protagonist
A high school girl with average looks and brains.
Has a dream, but her family and teachers disapprove.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Looks like that's all that's written.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm concerned about those crying sounds I heard before I touched the fragment... I think I'll take a look around.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh... There's another sheet of paper on the floor.
This one hasn't been crumpled up.

rows.Speaker: Somebody's Writing
rows.Line:
• The person she looks up to
The type of mature person the protagonist wishes to become.

rows.Speaker: Somebody's Writing
rows.Line: Extends a hand to the protagonist with a soft, warm smile, charming to all regardless of their age or gender.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... And the other sheet I picked up had the “protagonist”. Seems like these are background notes on the characters of a story.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Does that mean the owner of these feelings is writing a story of some kind?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Um...
Are you the owner of the feelings behind this fragment SEKAI?

SEKAI...?
I don't know what you're talking about, but the answer is no.
I'm “a high school girl with average looks and brains”...

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: I'm the “protagonist” who's yet to become anybody at all, and hasn't even been given a name.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: An average high schooler... The protagonist...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's what was written on this sheet of paper...! It was about you?

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: You were kind enough to pick up that crumpled sheet of paper. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
No, don't thank me.
Actually, I apologize. I shouldn't have read it without permission.

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line:
Don't worry about that.
It's just a piece of garbage now...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
But this is what brought you to life, isn't it?
Please, you shouldn't talk about it like that...

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line:
But of course I'd be tossed aside before long.
It was the same for all the other protagonists.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The owner of these feelings is writing a story, right? If so, surely they'd treat the protagonist with great care...

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: I get the sense that she hates herself, and hates the protagonists she creates.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (This sound of someone crying... It's the same as what I heard before I entered this SEKAI.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, the person crying is this SEKAI's...

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: It's fine. Half of me is made up of her, so I guess this just happens.

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: I get the sense that she hates herself, and hates the protagonists she creates.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (This protagonist... Did the owner of these feelings use herself as a base when making her?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I'm sure this protagonist was entrusted with all sorts of feelings and wishes when she was created...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (But the owner of those feelings hates herself, so she can't bring herself to like someone who's so similar...?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I don't think I can let things go on like this...)
